review_style.value: Reviews stacked PRs in pieces; subagents review too; hand-tweaks design
review_style.quote: Whole thing was stacked PRs so it was manageable to review and merge in in pieces

also.quote: I currently juggle a handful of consecutive Claude Code and OpenCode agents, but pay close attention to the diffs and regularly check code in an IDE.
My development velocity is far slower than Yegge since I only wrangle a few agents at a time and keep my eyes and hands on the code.
Ask for an independent review of every changed test.
Language is a poor medium for designing easing curves and describing aesthetic feelings – I always need to touch the CSS, and it’s often faster to just tweak directly than try to explain what I want.
So yes subs did cleanup but design system cleanup is quite human-in-the-loop and direct tweaking of values vs being “automated”
of course also had to do a good amount of final cleanup on the implementation with agentation + automated tests of all browser sizes and stress testing for edge cases.

harness.value: Orchestrator agent runs subagents; Chopin plan documents become stacked PRs
harness.quote: I always use an orchestrator which is the main agent I talk to and have them use subagents for implementation, testing, review, etc.

history.quote: > **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

signature.caption: her design taste, as a skill
signature.why: Our pick: she says design, not build time, is always her bottleneck, so she wrote her own design philosophy down for the agent.
signature.quote: My personal design philosophy. The core is: **minimalist, progressive, and dynamic.** Interfaces should feel spare, teach through interaction, and behave like live, responsive widgets rather than static documents.

archetype.why: Calls herself agentically conservative: a few agents, eyes on every diff, hands on the CSS.

signature_quote.value: My development velocity is far slower than Yegge since I only wrangle a few agents at a time and keep my eyes and hands on the code.
signature_quote.more: But the build time is rarely what holds me up.
